commits.message:
fix(docs): drop double-stacked newlines in group.md's Group examples (rich-flexstrip-5kf.c4u)

commit f1fa4c67 (rich-text-5ai) made RichText.render() draw its `end`
unconditionally. All three Group examples on docs/group.md built their
RichText/renderMarkup content with a literal trailing "\n" in the text
AND relied on the default end ("\n"), so every item printed a spurious
blank line after it. Drop the literal "\n"s and let the default `end`
supply the line break, matching what the page's shown output already
claims. Also corrects the explanatory paragraph, which asserted
`console.print` (not RichText itself) draws the default `end` -- true
before f1fa4c67, false since.

fix(strip): Strip ends its own last line, matching FlexStrip (#146)

* fix(strip): Strip ends its own last line, matching FlexStrip (rich-flexstrip-5kf)

Strip and FlexStrip are sibling renderables over the same Joiner protocol,
documented on one page, and disagreed about who terminates the last line:
FlexStrip ends every line with Segment.line(), Strip never emitted one.

Printed alone this was invisible — Console.print already closes whatever a
renderable left open (rich-console-dcg) — but it broke composition: docs/group.md
documents that Group inserts nothing between children, so each child must end
its own line the way Panel, Rule and Table already do. A Group of a Strip
followed by another renderable ran the two together on one line; the same
Group with a FlexStrip put the second renderable on its own line, as intended.

The original ticket framed the fix the other way (make FlexStrip stop
terminating, to match Strip) — investigation on the rich-console-dcg branch
found that backwards: FlexStrip already follows the codebase's convention
that every renderable ends its own lines, and Strip is the outlier. Fixed by
giving Strip the same trailing Segment.line() FlexStrip already emits.

Strip's own render-walk tests (joiner glyph/color placement) strip the new
terminator via a small helper so they stay focused on what they pin; the
terminator itself and the Group composition contract get dedicated tests.

* fix(strip): correct overclaiming comments from /code-review high

/code-review high on this branch caught two comments I wrote that overclaim
"every renderable ends its own last line" as a universal, checked fact. It
isn't: Spinner, ProgressBar, and StatusRenderable never yield a trailing
line terminator, verified live — they're line fragments, not block-level
renderables, and Group composition runs a bare Spinner into whatever follows
it. Corrected both comments to name that real exception instead of a false
universal, and filed rich-flexstrip-5kf.4cq to decide whether that split
should be a checked seam test.

The review also caught that docs/group.md's explanation of why RichText's
default `end` doesn't already close a directly-embedded line is now false
(RichText.render() emits `end` unconditionally since rich-text-5ai,
independent of Console) — and, discovered while verifying that, both
documented Group examples now print a spurious blank line per item as a
result. That's an unrelated, pre-existing regression from rich-text-5ai
(commit f1fa4c67), not something this branch touches or introduces; filed as
rich-flexstrip-5kf.c4u with a verified repro and fix direction rather than
folding an unrelated docs fix into this PR.
